PowerShell($tmp = Join-Path $env:TEMP "cormorant-garamond-install"; if \(Test-Path $tmp\) { Remove-Item $tmp -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $tmp | Out-Null; $files = @\("CormorantGaramond-Light.ttf","CormorantGaramond-LightItalic.ttf","CormorantGaramond-Regular.ttf","CormorantGaramond-Italic.ttf","CormorantGaramond-Medium.ttf","CormorantGaramond-MediumItalic.ttf","CormorantGaramond-SemiBold.ttf","CormorantGaramond-SemiBoldItalic.ttf","CormorantGaramond-Bold.ttf","CormorantGaramond-BoldItalic.ttf"\); foreach \($f in $files\) { $url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/cormorantgaramond/$f"; $dest = Join-Path $tmp $f; try { Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $dest -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output "OK  $f  $\(\(Get-Item $dest\).Length\) bytes" } catch { Write-Output "FAIL $f  $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } })

PowerShell($tmp = Join-Path $env:TEMP "cormorant-garamond-install"; if \(Test-Path $tmp\) { Remove-Item $tmp -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $tmp | Out-Null; $urls = @{ "CormorantGaramond-VF.ttf" = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/cormorantgaramond/CormorantGaramond%5Bwght%5D.ttf"; "CormorantGaramond-Italic-VF.ttf" = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/cormorantgaramond/CormorantGaramond-Italic%5Bwght%5D.ttf" }; foreach \($name in $urls.Keys\) { $dest = Join-Path $tmp $name; & curl.exe -sSL -o $dest $urls[$name]; Write-Output "$name -> $\(\(Get-Item $dest\).Length\) bytes" })

PowerShell($src = Join-Path $env:TEMP "cormorant-garamond-install"; $dst = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA "Microsoft\\Windows\\Fonts"; if \(-not \(Test-Path $dst\)\) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dst -Force | Out-Null }; $regKey = "HKCU:\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Fonts"; $entries = @{ "Cormorant Garamond \(TrueType\)" = "CormorantGaramond-VF.ttf"; "Cormorant Garamond Italic \(TrueType\)" = "CormorantGaramond-Italic-VF.ttf" }; foreach \($name in $entries.Keys\) { $file = $entries[$name]; $srcPath = Join-Path $src $file; $dstPath = Join-Path $dst $file; Copy-Item -LiteralPath $srcPath -Destination $dstPath -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path $regKey -Name $name -Value $dstPath -Type String; Write-Output "installed: $name -> $dstPath" })
